verdict.rationale: The evidence shows remote script execution, automated remediation, and automation of fixes for recurring issues. None of it documents letting a user define time-based or recurring schedules for jobs or workflows. 'Automating recurring fixes' describes remediating repeated problems, not a recurring scheduler, and one-off remote script execution cannot stand in for a recurring schedule. These are adjacent automation features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
